newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Unibank expected to offer incentives for IPO.
newsitem.headline: Unibank expected to offer incentives for IPO.

text.p: Indonesian medium size bank PT Unibank was expected to offer incentives to attract more local investors to buy its shares during an initial public offering planned in late March, an official with the underwriters said.

"To attract more local investors, the bank may be expected to offer incentives such as guaranteeing a certain amount of dividend for the next several years," Johan Yudha Santosa, director of PT Makindo, the lead managing underwriter for Unibank's listing, told reporters at an informal meeting.
Unibank, which planned to float around 30 percent of its shares, presented its listing plan to the Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) late last week, Santosa said.
He declined to give further details.
